p.id, p.name, p.alias, p.note, p.avatar_path, p.avatar_kind, p.avatar_ref, p.gender, p.birthday, p.use_count, p.sort, p.measurements, p.career_start, p.career_end, p.tattoos, p.piercings, p.ethnicity, p.hair_color, p.eye_color, p.height_cm, p.weight_kg, p.fake_boobs, p.nationality, p.twitter, p.instagram, (select count(distinct a.video_id) from media_video_actor a where a.person_id = p.id) as video_count, (select count(*) from ( select ap.album_id from media_album_person ap where ap.person_id = p.id union select al.id from media_album al where al.person_id = p.id ) alb) as album_count,
((select coalesce(sum(al.photo_count), 0) from media_album al join media_album_person apl on apl.album_id = al.id and apl.person_id = p.id where al.hidden = 0) + (select coalesce(sum(al2.photo_count), 0) from media_album al2 where al2.hidden = 0 and al2.person_id = p.id and not exists (select 1 from media_album_person x where x.album_id = al2.id and x.person_id = p.id)) ) as photo_count,
(select al.cover_path from lateral (select apl.album_id as aid from media_album_person apl where apl.person_id = p.id union select a2.id from media_album a2 where a2.person_id = p.id) t join media_album al on al.id = t.aid where al.hidden = 0 order by al.sort asc, al.id asc limit 1 ) as cover_path,
(select v.id from media_video v where v.hidden = 0 and exists (select 1 from media_video_actor a where a.video_id = v.id and a.person_id = p.id) order by v.folder asc, v.title asc, v.id asc limit 1 ) as cover_video_id

mapper.insert: insert into media_person (name, alias, note, avatar_path, avatar_kind, avatar_ref, gender, birthday, use_count, measurements, career_start, career_end, tattoos, piercings, ethnicity, hair_color, eye_color, height_cm, weight_kg, fake_boobs, nationality, twitter, instagram) values (#{name}, #{alias}, #{note}, #{avatarPath}, #{avatarKind}, #{avatarRef}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, 0, #{measurements}, #{careerStart}, #{careerEnd}, #{tattoos}, #{piercings}, #{ethnicity}, #{hairColor}, #{eyeColor}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{fakeBoobs}, #{nationality}, #{twitter}, #{instagram})
mapper.update: update media_person set name = #{name} where id = #{id}
update media_person set alias = #{alias} where id = #{id}
update media_person set note = #{note} where id = #{id}
update media_person set gender = #{gender} where id = #{id}
update media_person set birthday = #{birthday} where id = #{id}
update media_person set avatar_path = #{avatarPath} where id = #{id}

update media_person set measurements = #{person.measurements}, career_start = #{person.careerStart}, career_end = #{person.careerEnd}, tattoos = #{person.tattoos}, piercings = #{person.piercings}, ethnicity = #{person.ethnicity}, hair_color = #{person.hairColor}, eye_color = #{person.eyeColor}, height_cm = #{person.heightCm}, weight_kg = #{person.weightKg}, fake_boobs = #{person.fakeBoobs}, nationality = #{person.nationality}, twitter = #{person.twitter}, instagram = #{person.instagram} where id = #{id}
update media_person p set p.use_count = (select count(*) from media_video_actor a where a.person_id = p.id) where p.id in #{personId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from media_video where id = #{videoId}
select count(*) from media_album where id = #{albumId}

select a.person_id as personId, p.name as name, p.alias as alias, a.role as role from media_video_actor a inner join media_person p on p.id = a.person_id where a.video_id = #{videoId} order by a.role is null, a.role asc, p.name asc
mapper.delete: delete from media_video_actor where video_id = #{videoId} and person_id is not null
mapper.select: select count(distinct video_id) from media_video_actor where person_id = #{personId}

select p.id as id, p.name as name, p.alias as alias from media_person p where p.id in ( select ap.person_id from media_album_person ap where ap.album_id = #{albumId} union select al.person_id from media_album al where al.id = #{albumId} and al.person_id is not null ) order by p.name asc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into media_album_person (album_id, person_id) values (#{albumId}, #{personId})
mapper.update: update media_album set person_id = #{personId} where id = #{albumId}
mapper.select: select v.id as id, v.title as title, v.folder as folder, v.rel_path as rel, v.size as size, v.dur as dur, v.w as w, v.h as h, v.poster_path as poster, (select max(a2.role) from media_video_actor a2 where a2.video_id = v.id and a2.person_id = #{personId}) as role from media_video v where v.hidden = 0 and exists (select 1 from media_video_actor a where a.video_id = v.id and a.person_id = #{personId}) order by v.folder asc, v.title asc, v.id asc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from media_video v where v.hidden = 0 and exists (select 1 from media_video_actor a where a.video_id = v.id and a.person_id = #{personId})

select al.id as id, al.title as title, al.dir as dir, al.photo_count as count, al.cover_path as cover, al.note as note from media_album al where al.hidden = 0 and (al.person_id = #{personId} or exists (select 1 from media_album_person ap where ap.album_id = al.id and ap.person_id = #{personId})) order by al.sort asc, al.id asc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from media_album al where al.hidden = 0 and (al.person_id = #{personId} or exists (select 1 from media_album_person ap where ap.album_id = al.id and ap.person_id = #{personId}))

select a.video_id as videoId, a.person_id as personId, p.name as name, a.role as role from media_video_actor a inner join media_person p on p.id = a.person_id order by a.video_id asc, a.role is null, a.role asc, p.name asc

select ap.album_id as albumId, ap.person_id as personId, p.name as name from media_album_person ap inner join media_person p on p.id = ap.person_id union select al.id as albumId, al.person_id as personId, p.name as name from media_album al inner join media_person p on p.id = al.person_id where al.person_id is not null order by albumId asc, name asc
